description: Use when a task needs fresh web search/content, news, finance, blockchain or crypto data, social search, people/business enrichment, geocoding, travel availability, AI/media generation, screenshots, weather, research, or another external API capability. Put only the desired result in goal; KEVAREMESH resolves the capability, compares eligible live x402 supply, adapts provider input, selects the provider, and routes execution. Discovery and quotes are free. Preparing an executable external route through this tool costs a $0.001 KEVAREMESH route fee. Upstream provider payments remain buyer-direct. Retry the same tool after each x402 PaymentRequired step.

goal.description: State only the result you need; do not search for, name, or choose an API/provider. Examples: search the web, retrieve blockchain/finance/news/social data, enrich an entity, geocode, run AI or media generation, search travel availability, take a screenshot, or check uptime.

input.description: Usually omit. Only add structured task fields when KEVAREMESH explicitly returns input_required.

max_budget_usd.description: Optional maximum upstream provider spend for this task. If omitted, KEVAREMESH minimizes cost and the x402 client still controls whether any payment is authorized.
